_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for Way East facility billing. RULE CHANGED 2026-09-15 BY MATT: 'assume i trained at wingate everyday unless i say other wise.' So the default is now TAUGHT for any WEEKDAY that has already happened, on or after programStart. A day is excluded ONLY if it is a weekend, a listed closure, listed in confirmedNotTaught, or has not happened yet. Future dates are NEVER counted - a day that has not occurred is not revenue. confirmedTaught is kept as an explicit audit trail of days Matt confirmed by name, but it is no longer what gates the money. To exclude a day, add it to confirmedNotTaught with a reason - that is the 'unless I say otherwise'.
note: Way East bills per DAY - the $75 covers Rise and Move + Stability and Strength combined. Never bill $75 twice for one morning.
